fem.text: Havenwood is an elven forest where, after the Sylex Blast, Thelon cultivates fungus with green mana into thallids to raise saprolings for food, and the thallids save its elves from starvation and lead to the Thelonite order.
As the climate cools, many elves turn to Thallid farming for food, and some Thelonites turn to fertilizing with fresh blood in an attempt to keep Havenwood alive and growing.
The thallids grow sentient and aggressive, causing an elven rift led by Morgan and Loren, and after Morgan ambushes and kills Loren, the thallids overrun Havenwood in almost a day.
Tev, whose spark ignites and turns him draconic, incinerates thallids attacking Loren, though he leaves and Morgan kills Loren with a poisoned arrow.
